examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An authenticator `otpauth://` URI drawn as a QR code, named after what the scan does, with the setup key as text and a `CopyButton` beside it for people who cannot scan.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.summary: The same short link at `small` (128 px), `medium` (160 px) and `large` (224 px); the code stays dark on a light plate in both themes.
